# A listed package whose path below the hub makes no exported Go identifier fails
# muxt generate before anything is written. The error names the package and the
# namespace it would get.

! muxt generate
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt
! exists route_paths.go
! exists blog/template_routes.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/_1": {},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- _1/one.go --
package one

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /a Index()").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "a" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /b Index()").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Index() string { return "b" }
-- want-err.txt --
Error: package "example.com/m/_1" gets the route paths namespace "1", which is not an exported Go identifier; rename its directory
